purpose: Authorize a new isolated validator V4 for read-only validation of the already sealed V4 candidate 49-point pilot. Validator V1, permanently failed validator V2, validator V3, and every predecessor audit remain immutable.
allowed_changes: New validator V4 script, contract, binding, revision record, audit_v4 directory, and validation_v4 log directory only.
Contract status becomes FORMAL_V4_VALIDATOR_V4_SEALED_PILOT_POSTCHECK_ONLY; pilot_postcheck_enabled is true and full_postcheck_enabled remains false.
Audit paths, version labels, audit prefixes, report prose, and predecessor identity checks advance from validator V3 to validator V4.
The sealed V4 pilot manifest, run status, repeatability, run-1 baseline, external repeatability record, and two non-scientific wrapper failure records are hash-bound.
Precheck marker policy expects the sealed pilot marker and requires the full directory to remain absent without parsing per-route scientific results.
Validator-generated CSV files use UTF-8-SIG; all CSV reads continue to use UTF-8-SIG.
Repeatability reads the sealed long schema keys baseline_artifact_manifest_sha256 and repeat_artifact_manifest_sha256; current manifest SHA is independently recomputed.
Full-postcheck is rejected before any full candidate output is parsed.
prohibited_changes: Any change to Step-4 indexing or MAT transpose semantics.
Any change to Laurent or polynomial formulas, log-scaled spectral-norm SVD residuals, rho/stable gates, unmatched-root safety gates, HDF5 layout, checkpoint identity, or manifest identity logic.
Any change to the 1e-8 rho/residual gates, 1e-12 formula gate, rho<1 stable rule, or prior-failure verdicts.
Any modification of candidate, Step-4, original Step-5, validator V1/V2/V3, or predecessor audit files.
Any candidate computation or any full computation/postcheck.
